method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100
nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 26 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine two independent current-day observations (27 Nov) and preserve cross-source dispersion. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
nigeria_market_note: Two independent current-day observations were combined; the ranges preserve corroborated cross-source dispersion and are indicative, not executable quotes.
markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates (26 Nov); Kenya CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates for the 26 Nov close, published in the 27 Nov file (not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (27 Nov); Egypt CBE-attributed official mid-rates carried forward (25 Nov, true date shown).
